001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;

006
007import java.util.Set;

010@HistoryLogProps(
011    opCode = 203,
012    displayName = "Update Status",
013    internalName = "LID_UPDATE_STATUS"
014)
015public class UpdateStatusHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
016
017    private int swUpdateStatus;
018    private int metadataAndVersionStatus;
019    private int fullDlAndCrcStatus;
020    private int fileDlAndSideloadStatus;
021    private int externalFlashStatus;
022    private int updateSuccessful;
023    private long swPartNum;
024
025    public UpdateStatusHistoryLog() {}
026    public UpdateStatusHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int swUpdateStatus, int metadataAndVersionStatus, int fullDlAndCrcStatus, int fileDlAndSideloadStatus, int externalFlashStatus, int updateSuccessful, long swPartNum) {
027        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
028        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, swUpdateStatus, metadataAndVersionStatus, fullDlAndCrcStatus, fileDlAndSideloadStatus, externalFlashStatus, updateSuccessful, swPartNum);
029        this.swUpdateStatus = swUpdateStatus;
030        this.metadataAndVersionStatus = metadataAndVersionStatus;
031        this.fullDlAndCrcStatus = fullDlAndCrcStatus;
032        this.fileDlAndSideloadStatus = fileDlAndSideloadStatus;
033        this.externalFlashStatus = externalFlashStatus;
034        this.updateSuccessful = updateSuccessful;
035        this.swPartNum = swPartNum;
036
037    }
038
039    public UpdateStatusHistoryLog(int swUpdateStatus, int metadataAndVersionStatus, int fullDlAndCrcStatus, int fileDlAndSideloadStatus, int externalFlashStatus, int updateSuccessful, long swPartNum) {
040        this(0, 0, swUpdateStatus, metadataAndVersionStatus, fullDlAndCrcStatus, fileDlAndSideloadStatus, externalFlashStatus, updateSuccessful, swPartNum);
041    }
042
043    public int typeId() {
044        return 203;
045    }
046
047    /**
048     * <table border="1">
049     * <caption>Parsed fields for UpdateStatusHistoryLog:</caption>
050     * <tr><td><code>swUpdateStatus</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
051     * <tr><td><code>metadataAndVersionStatus</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
052     * <tr><td><code>fullDlAndCrcStatus</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
053     * <tr><td><code>fileDlAndSideloadStatus</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
054     * <tr><td><code>externalFlashStatus</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>updateSuccessful</code></td><td><code>raw[20] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>swPartNum</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
057     * </table>
058     */
059    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
060        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
061        this.cargo = raw;
062        parseBase(raw);
063        this.swUpdateStatus = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
064        this.metadataAndVersionStatus = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
065        this.fullDlAndCrcStatus = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
066        this.fileDlAndSideloadStatus = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
067        this.externalFlashStatus = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
068        this.updateSuccessful = raw[20] & 0xFF;
069        this.swPartNum = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
070
071    }
072
073    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int swUpdateStatus, int metadataAndVersionStatus, int fullDlAndCrcStatus, int fileDlAndSideloadStatus, int externalFlashStatus, int updateSuccessful, long swPartNum) {
074        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
075            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(203, 0),
076            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
077            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
078            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(swUpdateStatus),
079            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(metadataAndVersionStatus),
080            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(fullDlAndCrcStatus),
081            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(fileDlAndSideloadStatus),
082            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(externalFlashStatus),
083            new byte[]{(byte) updateSuccessful, 0},
084            Bytes.toUint32(swPartNum)));
085    }
086
087    public int getSwUpdateStatus() {
088        return swUpdateStatus;
089    }
090
091    public int getMetadataAndVersionStatus() {
092        return metadataAndVersionStatus;
093    }
094
095    public int getFullDlAndCrcStatus() {

097    }
098
099    public int getFileDlAndSideloadStatus() {
100        return fileDlAndSideloadStatus;
101    }
102
103    public int getExternalFlashStatus() {
104        return externalFlashStatus;
105    }
106
107    /**
108     * @return raw updateSuccessful status; see {@link UpdateSuccessful} for known values
109     */
110    public int getUpdateSuccessful() {
111        return updateSuccessful;
112    }
113
114    public UpdateSuccessful getUpdateSuccessfulEnum() {
115        return UpdateSuccessful.fromId(updateSuccessful);
116    }
117
118    public long getSwPartNum() {

120    }
121
122    public Set<SwUpdateStatus> getSwUpdateStatusSet() {
123        return SwUpdateStatus.fromBitmask(swUpdateStatus);
124    }
125    public Set<MetadataAndVersionStatus> getMetadataAndVersionStatusSet() {
126        return MetadataAndVersionStatus.fromBitmask(metadataAndVersionStatus);
127    }
128    public Set<FullDlAndCrcStatus> getFullDlAndCrcStatusSet() {

130    }
131    public Set<FileDlAndSideloadStatus> getFileDlAndSideloadStatusSet() {
132        return FileDlAndSideloadStatus.fromBitmask(fileDlAndSideloadStatus);
133    }
134
135    public enum UpdateSuccessful {
136        NOT_SUCCESSFUL(0),
137        SUCCESSFUL(1),
138
139        ;
140        private final int id;
141        UpdateSuccessful(int id) {
142            this.id = id;
143        }
144
145        static UpdateSuccessful fromId(int id) {
146            for (UpdateSuccessful r : values()) {
147                if (r.id == id) {
148                    return r;
149                }
150            }
151            return null;
152        }
153    }
154
155    /**
156     * Bits 0-7: component update succeeded; bits 8-15: component update failed (Tandem schema SwUpdateStatus).
157     */
158    public enum SwUpdateStatus {
159        ARM_UPDATE_SUCCESS(1),
160        MSP_UPDATE_SUCCESS(2),
161        RADIO_PROCESSOR_UPDATE_SUCCESS(4),
162        ALPHAMASKS_UPDATE_SUCCESS(8),
163        RASTER_UPDATE_SUCCESS(16),
164        RADIO_APPLICATION_UPDATE_SUCCESS(32),
165        RADIO_BOOTLOADER_UPDATE_SUCCESS(64),
166        RADIO_STACK_UPDATE_SUCCESS(128),
167        ARM_UPDATE_FAILED(256),
168        MSP_UPDATE_FAILED(512),
169        RADIO_PROCESSOR_UPDATE_FAILED(1024),
170        ALPHAMASKS_UPDATE_FAILED(2048),
171        RASTER_UPDATE_FAILED(4096),
172        RADIO_APPLICATION_UPDATE_FAILED(8192),
173        RADIO_BOOTLOADER_UPDATE_FAILED(16384),
174        RADIO_STACK_UPDATE_FAILED(32768),
175        ;
176
177        private final int mask;
178        SwUpdateStatus(int mask) {
179            this.mask = mask;
180        }
181
182        public static Set<SwUpdateStatus> fromBitmask(int bitmask) {
183            Set<SwUpdateStatus> items = new TreeSet<>();
184            for (SwUpdateStatus i : values()) {
185                if ((bitmask & i.mask) != 0) {
186                    items.add(i);
187                }
188            }
189            return items;
190        }
191
192        public int getMask() {
193            return mask;
194        }
195    }
